GUI95 · Widget reference

38 examples

Small working examples for the Windows 95 control families and common dialog patterns. Every example is a self-contained HTML file: copy it, open it locally, and adapt only the controls you need.

These are original browser implementations. Native Open, Save, Print and rich-text editing use browser adapters with explicit limits. They do not reproduce every Windows API or later common control.
